newsitem.title: USA: South Lake Tahoe, Calif., okays budget cuts - paper.
newsitem.headline: South Lake Tahoe, Calif., okays budget cuts - paper.

text.p: South Lake Tahoe's city council, facing a four-year budget deficit of $1.4 million, approved some of the toughest cost-cutting measures in city history, according to a published report on Wednesday.
The Sacramento Bee newspaper reported that the reorganization of all city departments -- including the merger of the police and fire departments -- had been forced by major income losses.
"The state of California cut back our property tax revenues by a million dollars, so that was money we could not spend," Kerry Miller, city manager, told the newspaper.

When an attempt by the city to boost tax revenue by levying a fire protection fee on all property owners was rejected by voters last November, Miller said the budget cuts became unavoidable, the newspaper reported.
Miller was not immediately available to comment on the report.
